paper_title: ResTabNet: Residual Attention Architectures for Tabular Benchmarks
paper_text: Abstract: We present ResTabNet, a novel architecture for tabular benchmark classification. Across 10-fold cross-validation on the Adult Census benchmark (n=1000 samples), ResTabNet achieves an accuracy of 0.894 (95% CI: [0.881, 0.907]), outperforming the XGBoost baseline of 0.862 (p = 0.004). We trained using AdamW with learning rate 1e-4 and random seed 42.

paper_title: GNN-Reproduce: Inductive Node Classification on Citation Networks
paper_text: We evaluate GNN-Reproduce on the Cora citation benchmark across 500 test nodes. The model demonstrates a micro-F1 score of 0.835 (95% Wilson CI: [0.801, 0.865]), compared to GCN baseline of 0.815 (p = 0.021). Optimization conducted using SGD with momentum 0.9 and fixed seed 1337.
